name: Torre Alháquime (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torre Alháquime (a donjoned tower with a red flag between two dogs on white).
history: The flag is rectangular of proportions 2:3, divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly, white in the upper portion and red in the lower; the arms are argent, a donjoned tower proper surmounted by a flag gules on a base vert, between two dogs sable tied to the door.

features.role: Torre Alháquime arms — donjoned tower with a flag between two dogs
